items.title: Bumble Inc. Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
Bumble Announces Two New Features For Confidence and Clarity in Dating
items.summary: AUSTIN, Texas - February 26, 2026 - Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL) today announced two new features designed to help our community move from matching to meaningful connection with greater confidence and clarity. The first, AI-suggested Profile Guidance , is a comprehensive profile enhancement rolling out globally. It delivers personalized, actionable feedback on your bio and prompts as you build your profile, guiding members step by step to help truly reflect who they are. The impact of having a strong Bumble profile is clear: bios that are conversational, humorous, or spark curiosity outperform generic ones. The data backs it up, with nearly 60% of members with strong bios seeing higher engagement in mutual conversations. Additionally, women with two to three prompts received one-third more responses to their messages compared to those with none. items.title: Bumble Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2025 Results
Bumble Inc. Announces New Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Bumble Inc. (NASDAQ: BMBL) today announced the appointment of Kevin D. Cook as the Company’s Chief Financial Officer, effective August 12, 2025. Mr. Cook succeeds Ronald J. Fior, who is stepping down from his role as Interim Chief Financial Officer and will serve in an advisory role through the end of August to help ensure a smooth transition. Mr. Cook brings more than 30 years of financial management experience to Bumble, having served most recently as the Chief Financial Officer at Cloudera, Inc., a hybrid cloud data and AI platform company.
